p: one may not weigh gold dinars with it … And … even … to redeem other second-tithe … with it, … Granted,

one may not weigh gold dinars with it in order to determine their precise weight. And doing so is prohibited even if he is weighing the coin in order to redeem other second-tithe produce with it, as one may not derive benefit from tithe money. The Gemara discusses this matter: Granted,

he would light the … from it … and with it he would conclude, … But isn’t it true that here, … since the lamps were fixed … There was no alternative to taking … and lighting

he would light the others from it each day and with it he would conclude, i.e., the westernmost lamp would continue burning throughout the day after all the others were extinguished. The rest of the lamps burned only at night, and each night he would relight the rest of the lamps from the westernmost lamp. But isn’t it true that here, in the Temple, since the lamps were fixed in the candelabrum, it was impossible to light directly from lamp to lamp?
